title: I_O_Callaghan_Entity
description: Represents a registered corporate entity within the O'Callaghan ecosystem. This schema defines the structural identity of a subsidiary, partner, or shell corporation, tracking its legal standing, fiscal routing endpoints, and operational feature sets.

companyName.description: The full legal registered name of the corporate entity.

globalIndex.description: The unique immutable identifier for the entity within the global registry. Must adhere to the 'OC-ENT-XXX' format where XXX represents an alphanumeric sequence.

incorporationDate.description: The ISO 8601 date marking the official legal incorporation of the entity.

sovereignJurisdiction.description: The primary geopolitical or extra-territorial jurisdiction governing the entity's legal compliance and tax obligations.

fiscalEndpoint.description: The secure HTTPS endpoint used for automated fiscal reporting, tax deduction, and audit trail synchronization.

useCaseVector.description: A collection of operational verticals or strategic vectors that this entity is authorized to pursue.

featureSet.description: A complex object defining the specific capabilities, limits, and active modules enabled for this entity.

maxConcurrentTransactions.description: The hard limit on parallel financial operations allowed for this entity.

auditLevel.description: The depth of automated auditing applied to the entity's ledger.

isActive.description: Flag indicating if the entity is currently operational.
